requirement: OPS-05「研究者可以使用可驗證的裝置稀疏前向與反向。驗收：與 CPU 比對、裝置更新／恢復測試及實際量測；未測不標通過。」
scope: Partial OPS-05 progress: backend capability/fallback/ledger checks, hardware WebGPU float32 sparse drive and sparse local derivative, scalar zero-delay recurrent dynamics adapter, and opt-in episode trainer with CPU AdamW and JSON snapshot restart. Device-side optimizer update and resident state remain incomplete.
reproduction_command: See evidence/OPS-05/gpu-trainer-20260925/verification.json for targeted GPU trainer, 20-repeat, race, full learning and vet commands.
environment: Mac15,12 Apple M3, 16 GiB unified memory, darwin/arm64, Go 1.26.5; selected hardware WebGPU adapter Apple M3 via Metal. Ubuntu 1 RTX 4070 and Windows GPU were not executed.

observed_result.status: specified: Mac Metal sparse primitives and opt-in episode trainer pass scoped CPU comparisons and new-process JSON snapshot continuation; full OPS-05 remains incomplete.
observed_result.ready: WebGPU float32 sparse drive and local derivatives execute on Apple M3 Metal without silent CPU fallback. 130 nodes/910 edges match independent float32 CPU results with max absolute difference 0; stress 20/100 repetitions and race passed. NewGPUTrainer Step, StepFrom, AdamW moments and new-process JSON snapshot continuation match CPU or uninterrupted GPU paths in 4-node fixture with no GPU skips; see sparse-backward-20260925/verification.json and gpu-trainer-20260925/verification.json.
observed_result.missing: No device-side optimizer update, persistent device-state save/restore, full-graph capacity/speedup benchmark or GPU memory measurement. GPUContinuous supports scalar zero-delay continuous dynamics only, keeping activation and state update on CPU and transferring values each step. Ubuntu 1 and Windows hardware execution are unverified; direct Mac SSH to Ubuntu 1 rejects authentication and this task has no remote command channel.
observed_result.next_acceptance: Implement device-side update and state lifecycle without changing CPU contracts; measure transfer/compute, memory and speedup on representative graphs, then execute on Ubuntu 1 and Windows when a command channel is available.

assumption_statement: Insyra v0.3.2 can accelerate eligible dense float32 matrix multiplication, but it does not expose CoImNet sparse recurrent device execution. The Mac WebGPU primitive timings are host wall-clock observations, not a full-model speedup or an Ubuntu performance prediction.
limitations: Full OPS-05 acceptance is incomplete and remains specified, not passed.
The host phase times are single observations, not GPU timestamp-query or CPU-versus-GPU speedup measurements.

The original source-row WGSL weight gradient output sometimes left slots unwritten on Metal; separate per-edge writes and sentinel regression now pass, but the underlying compiler/driver layer was not identified.
Ubuntu 1 and Windows GPU execution are not verified.
Insyra sparse recurrent device API gap is tracked at https://github.com/HazelnutParadise/insyra/issues/379.
